times.source_text: -The following is a summary of the warnings issued for the main affected areas of the province of Valencia: On the 2nd day in the morning, yellow warnings of 20 mm of precipitation were issued in one hour planned for the whole day 3 in the southern coast of Valencia. At night, the warnings were raised to orange of 50 mm of precipitation in one hour and an orange warning of 150 mm of precipitation was issued in twelve hours. On the 3rd day at 8:25 hours the accumulations of the precipitation warnings were reduced: in an hour to 40 mm and in twelve hours to 100 mm. At 15:50 hours the warning was raised to red of precipitation of 90 mm in an hour between 18:00 and 22:00 hours.

times.source_text: -The warnings issued for the main affected areas of the province of Tarragona were the following: On the 31st day in the evening, yellow warnings of 60 mm were issued in twelve hours and 20 mm in an hour on the South Coast and Prelithoral of Tarragona for the morning of the day 3. On the 2nd day in the morning, orange warnings of precipitation of 40 mm were placed in an hour in these zones for the second half of the day 3, and also yellow warnings of precipitation of 60 mm in twelve hours and 20 mm in an hour in the remaining areas of Tarragona, all for the day 3. In the evening, the warnings of precipitation were raised in twelve hours on the South Coast and South Prelithal with an accumulation of 150 mm in 12 hours. On the 3rd day in the morning the warnings of Tarragona are prolonged to include the morning of the day 4. On the 4th at 00:47 hours the notice of immediate prediction of precipitation of 40 mm in an hour on the north coast of Tarragona.The accumulated one was also raised in twelve hours to 90 mm for this area, although it remained the yellow level. At 1:17 hours the yellow warnings of Prelithoral north of Tarragona were raised to orange, with accumulated 40 mm in an hour and 120 mm in twelve hours. The yellow warning of precipitation of Litoral north of Tarragona was raised to the orange level with 150 mm in 12 hours.
